name: Bloodstained Dahlia
source:
In a world where people with supernatural abilities - singularities - exist, Dahlia, a young girl who killed her own family and most people in her native town, is saved from the police by a mysterious woman called Eleonora, who says she is going to teach her how to find happiness.

[From [url=https://selenn.itch.io/bloodstained-dahlia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个存在着超能力者——“特异点”——的世界里，亲手杀害了家人与家乡绝大多数镇民的少女达莉亚，被名叫埃莉诺拉的神秘女子从警方手中救走；而对方声称，自己将会教会她如何寻找幸福。

[摘自[url=https://selenn.itch.io/bloodstained-dahlia]itch.io[/url]]
